scoring_justification: Checker recomputes minimum-energy angles from the agent's raw V_theta curves CSV and compares to paper-reported minima (SiHNSi2: 101.5°, dihydrogenated: 109.5°).

outputs.description: CSV of computed V^θ values for each site type, bond, and angle.

schema.description: Object mapping site_type (string) to the minimum angle in degrees (float) that minimizes V^θ.

outputs.description: JSON summary of minimum-energy angles for each site type.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the minimum angles from the CSV and compare against the paper-reported values; the JSON is also cross-checked for consistency with the CSV-derived minima.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected minimum-energy bond angles for key tetrahedral sites
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the elastic deformation energy of the Si HNSi2 site is minimum for thetaSiSiSi = 101.5°' and 'all dihydrogenated sites have their deformation energy minimized by the regular geometry' (i.e., 109.5°).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's explicit numerical statements and text description of Figure 2.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published quantitative results; the exact numbers are stated in the paper.
